title: Zainab se kaha sheh ne alam qaime me lakar mai hogaya tanha
body:
ZAINAB SE KAHA SHEH NE ALAM KHAIME MEIN LAKAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
MARAGAYE DARYA PA ALAMDAR BARADAR MAIN HOGAYA TAHNA
DARYA PA KAATE MERE ALAMDAR KE SHAANE JAB AHLE JAFA NE, HAMLA KIYA PICCHE SE MERE BHAI PA CHUP KAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
GHERE HUE HAIN CHARO TARAF SE SITAM EJAAD TAYYAR HAIN JALLAD, GARDANPA CHALEGA MERI AB SHUMR KA KHANJAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
<<DIVIDER>>
SAR KAAT KE NAIZE PA CHADHEYENGE AB ADA YE ZULM BHI HOGA, AB KOUN BACHAYEGA MUJHE AAYE MERI QAHAR MAIN HOGAYA TAHNA
AKBAR HAI QASIM HAI NA HAI OUN MOHAMMED HAI ZULM KI YE HADD, SAAB LUT GAYA KARBAL MEIN MERA HAYE BHARA GHAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
DIL ZAKHMI NAZAR ZAKHMI KAMAR TUTI HUI HAI AFAAT KI GHADI HAI, ROTA HOON BHAI KOTOHHASTEY HAIN SITAMGAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
AB KOI BHI JINE KI MUJHE AAS NAHIN HAI ABBAS NAHIN HAI, BIN BHAI KE IS DASHT MEIN ZINDA RAHOO KYON KAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
<<DIVIDER>>
KHAIMO KO JALAYENGE SARE SHAAM YE AZLAM IS BAAT KA HAI GHAM, CHEEN JAYEGI ZAINAB TERE SAR SE TERI CHADAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
YE NOUHA HAMEED AUR HASAN KA JO NAYA HAI AWAAZE AZAA HAI, HAIN BAIN MERE HAAL PA DONO KI ZUBAAN PAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA..
